colleges.name: University of the District of Columbia (UDC) Workforce Development and Lifelong Learning (WDLL)
programs: Construction Craft Skills and Carpentry I-A
Construction Craft Skills and Electrical I-A
Construction Craft Skills and NCCER HVAC Level 1-A
colleges.credentials: Page lists NCCER-based construction craft skills levels and program flyers. Continuing Education also offers HVAC/R Technician (Voucher Included) and a Skilled Trades and Industrial category.

unions.name: IBEW Local 26
unions.description: IBEW Local 26 represents electricians in DC, Maryland and Virginia and runs tuition-free, earn-while-you-learn apprenticeship training.

unions.name: Plumbers & Gasfitters Local Union 5 (Apprenticeship School)
unions.description: Plumbers and Gasfitters Local 5 runs a UA-affiliated apprenticeship school for plumbers and gasfitters, with training classes and apprentice applications.

unions.name: SMART Local 100 (Sheet Metal Workers)
unions.description: SMART Local 100 trains apprentices to become journeymen sheet metal workers.
unions.how_to_apply: Apply through the apprenticeship page: https://smart100.org/apprenticeships/

unions.name: BAC Local 1 MVD (Bricklayers, Maryland, Virginia and DC)
unions.description: BAC Local 1 MD, VA and DC trains masons to contemporary construction, code and safety standards.

unions.name: Metropolitan Washington Council, AFL-CIO (Apprenticeship Directory)
trades: building trades (directory of affiliate union apprenticeships)
unions.description: Central labor council whose apprenticeship directory lists affiliate union apprenticeship programs; applications are accepted year round through an online form.
unions.how_to_apply: Use the online apprenticeship directory form listed on the page.

unions.name: ABC Metropolitan Washington - Apprenticeship and Skills Training (CraftMasters Trades Education)
unions.description: Associated Builders and Contractors chapter offering non-union apprenticeship and construction craft skills training through CraftMasters Trades Education.

unions.name: DC Students Construction Trades Foundation
unions.description: DC Students Construction Trades Foundation sponsors career tech and adult job training and pre-apprenticeship instruction for construction work in the District.
unions.how_to_apply: Adult job training (ages 18+) via contact form: https://dcstudentsctf.org/adult-job-training/ . Training is delivered through community partners including Catholic Charities and United Planning Organization.

unions.name: Catholic Charities DC - Pre-Apprenticeship Green Construction Training
unions.description: Pre-apprenticeship program that prepares participants for careers in green building; open to DC, Maryland and Virginia residents over 18.

unions.name: Helmets to Hardhats
unions.description: Connects veterans with construction apprenticeship careers and explains how to use GI Bill benefits for apprenticeship training.
unions.how_to_apply: Start at the Veterans page on the site: https://helmetstohardhats.org/

unions.name: DC Department of Employment Services - Office of Apprenticeship, Information and Training (OAIT)
unions.description: DC government office for registered apprenticeships, the DC Apprenticeship Council and construction project compliance.

unions.name: Building and construction trades council, District of Columbia (not verified)
unions.description: Standing up for Good Jobs and Strong Communities across the District of Columbia, Maryland and Virginia. More…

unions.name: Ironworkers Local 5
unions.description: Ironworkers Local Union 5 (chartered 1901), about 1,000 members in DC, Delaware, Maryland, Virginia and West Virginia; site describes a training facility and a nationally accredited apprenticeship program.
unions.how_to_apply: Use the Apprenticeship & Training section of the site; phone (301) 599-0960 is listed on the page.

unions.name: International Union of Operating Engineers Local 99
unions.description: IUOE Local 99: members operate and maintain boilers, chillers, generators and automated building systems; site has a Training & Education section.
unions.how_to_apply: Use the Training & Education section of the site.

licensing.name: DC Board of Industrial Trades (Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection, DLCP)
licensing.description: Licenses plumbers, electricians, refrigeration and air conditioning mechanics, steam and operating engineers, asbestos workers and elevator trades in DC. Board meets quarterly; applicants apply for a license through the DLCP site.

funding.name: DC Tuition Assistance Grant (DCTAG)
funding.provider: DC Office of the State Superintendent of Education (OSSE)
funding.provides: Grant for DC residents attending eligible public or private colleges and universities, applied for through DC OneApp.
funding.eligibility: US citizen or eligible non-citizen; attend an eligible college; DC resident for at least 12 consecutive months before first enrolling, and meet the other listed requirements (per page).
funding.how_to_apply: DC OneApp; the 2026-27 application period closed August 21, 2026 (per page). Must reapply yearly.

funding.name: Mayor's Scholars Undergraduate Program
funding.provider: DC Office of the State Superintendent of Education (OSSE)
funding.provides: Need-based last-dollar funding for DC residents earning a first associate or bachelor's degree at select area colleges and universities.

funding.name: DC Occupational Skills Training (Individual Training Accounts)
funding.provides: Individual Training Accounts for occupational skills training in high-demand sectors such as IT, health care, construction and sales/service.
funding.eligibility: Eligibility determined by a DOES Employment Specialist under WIOA criteria (per page).

funding.name: DC Registered Apprenticeships (OAIT)
funding.provider: DC Department of Employment Services, Office of Apprenticeship, Information and Training
funding.provides: Apprenticeship that combines on-the-job training with classroom instruction; OAIT oversees DC apprenticeship programs.

funding.name: DC Youth Services (Office of Youth Programs)
funding.provides: Youth programs offering skills training, work experience, academic enrichment and life skills training.
